name: Dive Bomber Push-Up
instructions: Begin in a downward dog yoga position with hips raised high and hands and feet on the ground.
Keep your legs and arms relatively straight.
Swoop your body down and forward in an arcing motion.
As you move forward, bend your arms and bring your chest close to the ground.
Continue the arc upward into an upward dog position, fully extending your arms.
Your hips should now be low and your chest up.
Reverse the motion by pushing back through the same arc to return to the starting position.
This creates a fluid, continuous movement working shoulders, chest, and core.
